title: fix(objectql)!: the by-name picklist read answers by package (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9GW8iHhjGJEd2B3D1Eofby5)_

Fixes #32070

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：选项列表（picklist）按名读取改走 ADR-0150 D3 的统一解析：两个包都有同名列表时，裸地址 `/meta/picklist/NAME` 返回 409 并列出两个包，不再随便给第一个；限定地址只命中真正持有它的包。
- 为什么改：#31700 收窄 picklist 的一持有者拒绝之前，每个按名读取方都必须按包解析；这是最后一个还在「取第一个」的 picklist 读取方。
- 风险与回滚：只有一行生产代码（类型清单加一项）。单持有者的裸地址和自己包的限定地址答案不变；限定地址指向不持有该名的包时由 200（返回别的包的列表）变为 409。回滚即撤回此 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts` 新增的 `'picklist'` 一行；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts` 新增的 `[#32070]` 一组。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts`，预期 11/11 通过，其中 7 条是本卡的 picklist 读取 pin。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`picklist` joins `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` (`packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-read.ts`), so the picklist's by-name read goes through the one package-scoped resolver (`resolvePackageScopedName`, ADR-0150 D3) exactly as child E8's nine types do. No new traversal and no first-match fallback: the readers already branch on `registry.readsByPackage(type)`, so the one line moves:

- the protocol's by-name read with no package (`GET /api/v1/meta/picklist/NAME`, both API faces);
- the exact qualifier of child G1 (`/meta/picklist/NAMESPACE/NAME`, `?package=ID`, `/meta/picklist/_env/NAME`);
- `MetadataFacade.get` / `getEntry` / `exists` (exported for downstream hosts; nothing in-tree installs it in the `metadata` slot).

A select field's `picklist:` reference is untouched: it already resolves by its referrer's package (child E6, `SchemaRegistry` field resolution over `resolvePackageScopedName`), not through `resolveItem`.

### Measured answers (booted showcase plus `com.qa.bare.alpha` (namespace `alpha`) and `com.qa.bare.beta` (namespace `beta`), both holding `qa_shared_status`, alpha alone holding `qa_alpha_status`; base `ff04ad81` vs head)

| Read | base | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `GET /meta/picklist/qa_shared_status` (two holders) | 200, alpha's list | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both packages |
| `/meta/picklist/alpha/qa_shared_status`, `?package=com.qa.bare.alpha` | 200 alpha | 200 alpha (unchanged) |
| `/meta/picklist/beta/qa_shared_status`, `?package=com.qa.bare.beta` | 200 beta | 200 beta (unchanged) |
| `/meta/picklist/_env/qa_shared_status` | 200, alpha's list | 409 naming both holders |
| `GET /meta/picklist/qa_alpha_status` (one holder), `/alpha/…`, `?package=…alpha` | 200 alpha | 200 alpha (unchanged) |
| `/meta/picklist/beta/qa_alpha_status`, `?package=com.qa.bare.beta` | **200, alpha's list** | 409 naming alpha |
| `/meta/picklist/_env/qa_alpha_status` | **200, alpha's list** | 409 naming alpha |
| zero holders, any address | 404 | 404 (unchanged) |
| `alpha_item.status` / `beta_item.status` served options | own package's | own package's (unchanged) |

### BREAKING (declared `no (narrowing)`, seat claim amendment 6760695604, G1's precedent)

1. A bare read of a name two packages hold served the first registered; it is now `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming both. Phase 1's install door already refuses the second holder, so only a deployment that booted with the clash (and was warned at boot) holds one.
2. A qualified read naming a package that does not hold the name (`/meta/picklist/NAMESPACE/NAME`, `?package=ID`, or `_env` when only a package holds it) answered 200 with another package's list; it is now `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holder.

FROM a bare read of a two-holder name TO `?package=ID` or `/meta/picklist/NAMESPACE/NAME`. FROM a qualified read naming a non-holder TO the holder's own namespace (the refusal names it), or the bare address.

First-party count: 0. No first-party package ships a picklist name another package ships (phase 1's census), and nothing first-party reads a picklist at a package that does not hold it (Studio sends the holder; `ui/` only lists `GET /meta/picklist`).

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts`, new top-level describe `#32070`: CONTROL (one holder served identically at the bare read, both faces, the exact qualifier and the facade; zero holders not-found; the environment's own list), two holders refused naming both, each package caller and each exact qualifier reaching its own list, a non-holding qualifier refused naming the holder.
- **Forced test change:** the same file's first pin asserted `PACKAGE_SCOPED_READ_TYPES` equals E8's nine; it now asserts E8's nine plus `WIRED_SINCE` (`['picklist']`).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/bare-name-one-holder.dogfood.test.ts` (the existing two-package harness; alpha gains the one-holder list `qa_alpha_status`): seven pins inside its booted describe for the HTTP doors above — the two-holder bare read, each holder's qualified addresses, one case per non-holding qualifier shape (namespace address, `?package=`, `_env`), the one-holder CONTROL, and E6's per-field options.

Ablation (committed fix first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` + `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`): `isPackageScopedReadType` made to answer `false` for `picklist` (marker spelled as a string so the DTS build stays green), objectql rebuilt, marker proved in `dist/`. Red: unit 2 of 78 (`two holders: the bare read refuses…`, `the exact qualifier of a package that does not hold the name…`: the read did not refuse), dogfood 4 of 11 (the two-holder bare read and each of the three non-holding qualifier shapes answered `200` with alpha's list, as on base). Restored: blob equals HEAD, `git status --porcelain` empty, rebuilt, `--absent` preflight clean, dogfood file 11/11 again. (A first attempt that dropped the list entry outright failed the DTS build on `registry.ts`'s type; its readings are not used.)

## Acceptance notes

- Out of scope by the seat's ruling: `readMetaItem`'s shared packageless branch falls back to `getItem` when the engine's registry has no `readsByPackage` (a composition without the resolver slice). It is shared by every package-scoped type, so it goes to the epic seat as an open question.
- `NAMESPACE_SCOPED_BARE_NAME_TYPES` is not touched; the narrowing of picklist's one-holder refusal is #31700's.

## Verification

All on head `8cdcb5b7`, base `ff04ad81` (main has since moved by two commits that touch none of these files).

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 65 derived commands, each run with its exit captured before any pipe, all 65 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 65 derived, 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero: every entry recorded its exit code). On the first sweep two exited 3 for this container, not the diff (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs its pinned fixture commit, fetched; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs every package built, built); both then exited 0.
- Lint: root eslint over `packages/objectql/src` and `packages/qa/dogfood/test` with `--no-inline-config`: exit 0 (neither package has its own `lint` script).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: 583 files, 12026 tests passed.
- Full dogfood battery (owed by the `(narrowing)` arm; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, no shard, under the verify lock): VERDICT command-exit 0, Test Files 446 passed / 3 skipped (449), Tests 3702 passed / 42 skipped (3744).
- CI check-runs: not read at report time.

<details><summary>Base vs head probe (untracked dogfood probe, not committed)</summary>

The table under What changes is read from two runs of the same untracked probe test, base `ff04ad81` and head, booting the showcase with the two packages. Each changed row's head answer is a `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` whose sentence names the holder(s) and ends "Address it by its holder." (qualified) or "Nothing picks one of them: address it by its package." (bare).

</details>
